methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.

stop_rule: Stop after this exact stream and prescribed controls; report a scoped failure if the unchanged native interface cannot represent its chronology. No optimization or engine changes.
evidence: Unchanged native legality and 5/9/11-stage column engines pass split94 and interleaved88; 883/1327/1549 formal columns, exact receipts and all inherited bridge controls.
